g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: FB1 BLM21PG221SN1D (220 ohm @ 100 MHz, 2 A, 45 mOhm) + C38/C39: pi-filter at the module's VBAT pad.

g.desc: FB1 BLM21PG221SN1D (220 ohm @ 100 MHz, 2 A, 45 mOhm) + C38/C39: pi-filter at the module's VBAT pad.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: R36 || R37 = 9.4k sets the full 1.3 A current limit. PG is not used (left open, as the datasheet allows).

g.desc: R36 || R37 = 9.4k sets the full 1.3 A current limit. PG is not used (left open, as the datasheet allows).

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: C34 on NR/SS filters the reference (start-up about 28 ms). C31-C35: X7R ceramics only - the output

g.desc: C34 on NR/SS filters the reference (start-up about 28 ms). C31-C35: X7R ceramics only - the output

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.3; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Headroom: 5 V - 4.2 V = 0.8 V; still 0.55 V if the Pi's 5 V sags to 4.75 V on TX.

g.desc: Headroom: 5 V - 4.2 V = 0.8 V; still 0.55 V if the Pi's 5 V sags to 4.75 V on TX.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: U7 TPS7A9401DSCR (TI): 1 A, 0.46 uVrms, PSRR 110 dB @ 1 kHz / 50 dB @ 1 MHz, dropout 240 mV max at 1 A.

g.desc: U7 TPS7A9401DSCR (TI): 1 A, 0.46 uVrms, PSRR 110 dB @ 1 kHz / 50 dB @ 1 MHz, dropout 240 mV max at 1 A.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.3; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: ENABLE: on at 1.22 V x (1 + R32/R35) = 3.9 V

g.desc: ENABLE: on at 1.22 V x (1 + R32/R35) = 3.9 V

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: R31 sets Vout with the internal 150 uA reference: thin film 0.1% for accuracy and low excess noise.

g.desc: R31 sets Vout with the internal 150 uA reference: thin film 0.1% for accuracy and low excess noise.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: needs 1-20 mOhm ESR and under 2 nH (datasheet 6.3), which rules out tantalum here.

g.desc: needs 1-20 mOhm ESR and under 2 nH (datasheet 6.3), which rules out tantalum here.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Layout: C31/C32 at IN, C33/C35 at OUT, grounds together at U7's GND with no vias in between.

g.desc: Layout: C31/C32 at IN, C33/C35 at OUT, grounds together at U7's GND with no vias in between.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: SNS (pin 8) Kelvin to C33. Thermal pad to a large ground area: 0.6 W on TX, RthJA 46 C/W (JEDEC).

g.desc: SNS (pin 8) Kelvin to C33. Thermal pad to a large ground area: 0.6 W on TX, RthJA 46 C/W (JEDEC).

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.4; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.15; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
